svg.title: LocalDeal · Database Relationships
svg.desc: Entity relationship diagram of fifteen SQLite tables, nineteen foreign keys and three read views. All required parent references are marked one; child collections are zero to many, except the zero or one redemption for each order.

g.title: users 1 → redemptions 0..N via staff_user_id
g.text: staff_user_id · authorized at the order’s branch
Each merchant has one owner user
One order permits at most one redemption
PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · UQ = unique constraint · ? = nullable. A child references exactly 1 parent; each parent has 0..N children.
Orders → redemptions is 1 to 0..1. Money uses integer HKD cents; timestamps use Unix seconds; expires_on values are Hong Kong calendar dates (UTC+8).
3 read views: store_summary · coupon_catalog · wallet. Wallet status is derived; purchase snapshots and redemption history remain immutable.
